text: Let's review what we learned. I showed you how to use a minimizer to find x such that f is minimized. I showed you how to minimize in multiple dimensions, and how to use a minimizer to build a parameterized model. Where can you go from here? There are a number of ways you can carry this forward. You can use functions besides polynomials, you can model stock prices, or you can optimize a portfolio.
